messages:
alex: heads-up — hit a weird routing tie on staging. incoming request had X-Client-Evidence + X-Forwarded-For + Authorization bearer. gateway picked tenant-A based on X-Client-Evidence, but the downstream quota attribution ended up on anonymous because auth context wasn't propagated. logs show deterministic tie-breaker fell back to UA heuristic :confused:
priya: ugh. do you have the raw headers/snippet? this sounds like our evidence-merging logic produced equal scores and we didn't persist the winning-evidence tag to the request context
alex: pasted minimal headers below:
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJ... (masked)
X-Client-Evidence: customer=tenant-A;score=0.45
User-Agent: RedwoodApp/1.2.3 (ios)
X-Forwarded-For: 34.12.45.23
```
request routing chose tenant-A but quota service saw no tenant in auth_context, so usage got billed to "default"
jamal: quick thought — we currently compute a score vector then pick top signal, but we don't atomically stamp the chosen signal into the trace before async fan-out. race between router and auth-propagation worker. we should either: 1) atomic header: X-Redwood-Winner=tenant-A (short-term) or 2) extend the routing decision into the request context the moment we accept it so every service reads the same source of truth
sasha: +1 on atomic header. but we need to be careful about spoofing — if we add X-Redwood-Winner we must sign it or only add inside edge-proxy. otherwise clients could fake tenant. Also need console UX: telemetry for "evidence vector" per request so ops can see which signal won (auth vs header vs ua)
priya: propose: edge-proxy sets X-RW-Routing-Signature and X-RW-Routing-Winner, signature validated by internal services. config example for router (WIP):
```
routing:
  evidence_weights:
    x-client-evidence: 0.7
    authorization: 0.9
    user-agent: 0.1
  tie_break: [authorization, x-client-evidence, user-agent]
  stamp_header: X-RW-Routing-Winner
  sign_header: X-RW-Routing-Signature
```
we also add a telemetry counter: routing.winner.{signal} and routing.evidence.vector histogram
jamal: signature scheme: HMAC with edge key rotated daily, validated by auth-service and quota-service. we can reuse existing KMS + edge signing code. fallback: services that can't validate should default to rejecting the winner header and fall back to best-effort derivation
alex: good. timeline? this is hitting staging CI tests — quotas flapping in canary. i'd like a short fix (atomic un-signed header but edge-only) and a follow-up for signed header + console metrics
sasha: for console/alerts: add a dashboard card showing routing.winner breakdown, and an alert when >1% of requests have ``winner=anonymous`` while auth header present. that will catch regressions during rollout
priya: i'll open a PR with the edge-proxy change + unit tests for tie scenarios. will include a flag to flip on the signed-header path. also adding logging field "routing_evidence" to trace.
jenkins-bot: deploy triggered: edge-proxy/patch-1752 -> staging :rocket:
alex: thanks — please @channel when sign-header flag is ready so we can coordinate quota-service validation and update canary profile
priya: noted. starting PR now :eyes:
